decisionsTitle: Under the new look: the language switch floats bottom right, and «Urmărește-ne» with Instagram, Facebook and Strava tops the desktop header (amending §708, §699, §262)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11:** «the language switchers are always on the bottom right» — asked which, he chose the public site's RO/EN switch, out of the header, as a small round button fixed in the bottom-right corner of every public page that stays while one scrolls. Then, with a screenshot of the new-look header («VINO CU NOI →» and the Instagram and Facebook marks): «on the desktop version, the social media button must be in the top right with an indicator saying "Follow us" and these 3 buttons: Insta, Facebook, Strava». Both apply under «Aspectul nou» only (decision 12 of `docs/REDESIGN.md`); off, every page is what it is today, and the backoffice never changes. The logo stays blue (§711).

**Decision — the language, one round button.** `FloatingLocaleSwitch` (a client island, for `LocaleSwitcher`'s one reason: it needs the path) is a «Limbă» navigation holding one 44-pixel round link (BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 6) to the language the visitor is not reading: that language's flag over its code («EN» on a Romanian page, «RO» on an English one), named and titled by the language in its own words («English», «Română»), never a flag alone. The site has two languages, so the one press a visitor needs is to the other; a two-flag pill would be two targets in a corner for a choice of one. The link is `LocaleSwitcher`'s own, `/api/locale?to=…&from=…`, which finds the page's other-language address on the server (an event's slugs differ by language, BR-REQ-040-01 criterion 5), so it works with scripts off; `rel="nofollow"` and `hreflang`; `localeSwitchHref`, exported by `LocaleSwitcher`, is the one copy of that link. A printed page hides the button (`@media print`). It reuses the switcher's words (`Site.language`, `languageCode`, `languageName`), so the islands' catalogue gains nothing. Amends criteria 6 and 7 of BR-REQ-040-01 under the look: the language is the floating round button in the bottom-right corner, which offers the one other language as a link (named in its own words) instead of the switcher in the site header that marks the current one; the link still lands on the same page in the other language, resolved on the server (criterion 6), and its flag is decoration over the language's code rather than beside it (criterion 7).

**Decision — where it floats.** The footer draws it, inside its sticky bar (`position: sticky; bottom: 0`, §323), absolutely placed 12 pixels above the bar's top edge and 16 from the right (or the device's safe area): the bar is on screen at every scroll position, so the button is too, and when the «Despre club» fold opens the bar grows upward and carries the button with it — it never sits over the bar's items or the fold's links, which a `position: fixed` at a guessed offset would have. The footer's layer (1000) puts it over the page and under the header, the ☰'s menu and every dialog. At a page's foot the mountain watermark (`LookWatermark`, drawn under the same setting, about a hundred pixels tall) is the room above the bar, so the page's own last control ends clear of it; the e2e gate scrolls to the end and finds no link, button, summary or field under it. The layout passes the setting to the footer (`<SiteFooter newLook={look.on} />`), so off the button is not in the markup at all; on, it is drawn only inside the look's scope (`onlyUnderLook`), so a backoffice page, which renders the same footer, never shows it.

**Decision — one «Limbă» at every width.** Under the scope the header's copy (from `sm`) and the phone's two flags with their rule on the footer's bar (§262, §385) are `display: none` through `notUnderLook`, the reverse of `onlyUnderLook` (`theme/look.ts`), so the header still names no look rule of its own on the logo (§711); off, and in the backoffice, both are exactly as they were. Amends criteria 40, 42, 48 and 59 of BR-REQ-041-01 under the look: below 600 px the footer's bar ends with the privacy link («GDPR») and the social marks, and the language is the floating button. The phone's bar gets its flags' room back and the header its far end.

**Decision — «Urmărește-ne».** `HeaderSocials` becomes a navigation named «Urmărește-ne» / "Follow us" (`Site.followUs`), the words drawn as its indicator (hidden from a screen reader, which hears the name once) and then Instagram, Facebook and Strava, in the owner's order (`HEADER_SOCIAL_ORDER`, `headerSocials`), each a 44-pixel round mark named by the club and the network («{club} pe Instagram» / "{club} on Instagram", `Site.followOn`), off-site in a new tab with `rel`, from the footer's one list (`clubSocialLinks`, §565) — an unset network is not drawn. It leaves the nav's trailing group (§708) and becomes the header row's last item, after the nav and its ☰, in the place the language switcher leaves under the look: the top right the owner asked for. **This amends §699 and criteria 206 and 207 of BR-REQ-041-01** (the ☰ as the row's right edge): under the look, from `md` up the ☰ is followed by «Urmărește-ne»; below `md` the ☰ stays the right edge. Outside the nav, so the nav measures its own box without it and folds a section into the ☰ before the row would wrap (§262, §569). From `md` up, as before; below, the footer's bar carries the marks and the phone's row is unchanged («Vino cu noi» still before the ☰, §699). Its box is drawn only where its content is (gated on the networks the club has set, not on the look), so it takes no room in the backoffice, on a phone, or with no profile set. The club's name in a mark's name comes from `CLUB_NAME` (§369), never typed, so a link met on its own — a screen reader going from link to link — says whose profile it is and where, which the navigation's name does not repeat on each one; the footer's marks keep the network alone under their own group's name. The design page's side-by-side (`/admin/design` → «Aspectul nou») draws both primitives, the language button in the flow.

**Decision — each Instagram mark its own gradient.** `SocialIcon` drew the Instagram gradient under one shared id, the browser taking the first. Harmless until the new look put a mark in the header that is `display: none` below `md`: a gradient inside a hidden SVG paints nothing, so the footer's Instagram, pointing at the header's, was an empty square on a phone under the look (found on this branch's screenshots; true since §708). Each mark now names its gradient with `useId` (letters and digits only, so the `url(#…)` needs no escaping), and the e2e gate checks that the footer's mark at 320 pixels paints with the gradient inside its own SVG.

**Refused:** a two-flag pill in the corner (two targets for a choice of one); `position: fixed` on the button (it would sit over the footer's bar and its open fold at a guessed offset); a page padding of its own under the look (the watermark is already that room); the switcher inside the header's ☰ menu (the owner asked for the corner); the socials kept inside the nav's trailing group (the ☰ would have stayed the row's right end, not the socials); a second list of the club's profiles; a remote logo or a network's script for the marks (the house's own inline SVG, §61); a floating button over a page's own bottom bar.

**The gate:** `tests/e2e/header-nav.spec.ts` (desktop project, serial, the setting flipped through «Setări» → «Aspect» and put back): off, no `floating-language` and no socials; on, at 320 and 1280 pixels exactly one «Limbă» navigation, the floating one, its «English» link to `/api/locale?to=en&from=…`, 44 pixels, at the bottom-right above the footer's bar, in view after a scroll to the end and covering no control there; at 1280 the «Urmărește-ne» navigation after the nav on the same row, its words drawn, its three links Instagram, Facebook, Strava, each named «{club} pe …», at 44 pixels. `tests/unit/appearance/floating-language.test.ts` renders the footer off and on and the button in both languages; `site-look-header.test.ts` holds the socials' order, their names in both languages from the catalogues and their place after the nav, and that the header's language box is hidden inside the look's scope; the same gate visits the seeded event page at 320 pixels and checks each social link against the configured address; `design-page.test.ts` asserts the design page draws the language row and `floating-language`. `site-look.test.ts` pins the layout's prop and the two hidden copies.
changelogLine: - **«Aspectul nou»: the language floats bottom-right, «Urmărește-ne» tops the desktop header** — under the new look the RO/EN switch is one small round button in the bottom-right corner of every public page, above the footer's bar, that stays while you scroll; on a computer the header ends with «Urmărește-ne» / "Follow us" and Instagram, Facebook and Strava. The footer's Instagram mark is no longer blank on a phone under the new look. Off, nothing changes; the backoffice never does. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: With «Aspectul nou» on, every public page carries exactly one «Limbă» navigation at every width: a 44-pixel round button in the bottom-right corner, just above the footer's sticky bar, that stays on screen while the page scrolls and covers none of the page's controls at its end, linking to the language the visitor is not reading through `/api/locale` and named by that language in its own words; the header's copy and the phone's flags on the footer's bar are hidden, and with the setting off neither the button nor any change to the two copies is drawn. Amends criteria 40, 42, 48 and 59 of BR-REQ-041-01 under the look: below 600 px the footer's bar ends with the privacy link («GDPR») and the social marks, and the language is the floating button (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

With «Aspectul nou» on, from `md` up the header row ends — after the nav and its ☰, on the same row — with a navigation named «Urmărește-ne» / "Follow us" that shows those words and the club's Instagram, Facebook and Strava, in that order, each a 44-pixel target from the footer's one list, named by the club and the network («{club} pe Instagram» / "{club} on Instagram", the club's name from `CLUB_NAME`); below `md` and in the backoffice it is not drawn. Amends criteria 206 and 207: under the look, from `md` up the ☰ is followed by «Urmărește-ne», and it stays the row's right edge below `md` (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Under «Aspectul nou» the language is the floating round button in the bottom-right corner instead of the switcher in the site header: it offers the one other language as a link named in its own words and marks no current language, it still lands on the same page in the other language, resolved on the server, and its flag is decoration over the language's code rather than beside it. This amends criteria 6 and 7 (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
